title: ECINET Audit Finds State-Level Access Could be Restricted by Election Commission, VIP Tags for Voters
shows: The fullest report of Saurav Rajput's review of ECINET's publicly served code for the civic-tech initiative Charchagram. Beyond the State Nodal Officer controls and the West Bengal rule, it reports a gold VIP symbol against some voters on officials' screens and a button that downloads a list of these voters by constituency. The review cannot say whether any feature was used, and the criteria for marking a voter are not known.
quote: The Charchagram audit does not establish whether these access controls were used, by whom or how frequently.
The criteria for marking a star against any voter are not known from the available information.
